result.topic_en: Euler illustrates the variation of an integral formula with the example of the time of descent of a body along a curve, where Z = √(1+pp)/√x, and begins discussing how such an integral formula must be determined.
result.transcription:
VARIATIONVM TRACTANDI. 55

cuiuspiam integralis $\int Z\,dx$, qui ſit $= W$, quo
poſito conſideretur alia curua quaecunque $\alpha\mu$ in-
finite parum a data diſcrepans, ac ſi pro hac curua
itidem definiatur valor formulae $\int Z\,dx$, quaeritur,
quantum iſte valor a praecedente ſit diſcrepaturus;
euidens enim eſt, hoc diſcrimen praebere ipſam
variationem quantitatis $W$, quam ſupra ope calculi
variationum exhibuimus.

33. Quo haec adhuc clariora euadant, exem-
plum quodpiam proferamus, quo propoſita curua
A M eiusque axe A P tamquam verticali conſiderato,
quaeritur tempus quo corpus ex puncto A ſuper hac
curua AM deſcendens vsque ad punctum M per-
tingit. Iam quia celeritas corporis in M, eſt vt $\sqrt{AP} = \sqrt{x}$
et ipſum curuae elementum $= dx\sqrt{(1+pp)}$,
poſito ſcilicet $dy = p\,dx$ vti in ſolutione generali
eſt praeceptum; erit tempus per elementum Mm
$= dx\frac{\sqrt{(1+pp)}}{\sqrt{x}}$ vnde formula integralis $\int Z\,dx$ pro hoc
caſu abit in $\int dx\frac{\sqrt{(1+pp)}}{\sqrt{x}}$, ita vt habeatur $Z = \frac{\sqrt{(1+pp)}}{\sqrt{x}}$,
quare nunc tempus erit definiendum, quo corpus
ſuper curua quacunque proxima $\alpha\mu$ deſcendens ab
$\alpha$ vsque ad $\mu$ perueniet, vbi diſcrimen dabit ipſam
variationem formulae $\int dx\frac{\sqrt{(1+pp)}}{\sqrt{x}}$ huic caſui con-
uenientem.

34. Quoniam hic formula integralis conſide-
randa venit, ante omnia diſpiciendum eſt, quomo-
do eam determinari oporteat. In exemplo quidem
allato, manifeſtum eſt formulae $\int\frac{dx\sqrt{(1+pp)}}{\sqrt{x}}$ inte-
grale

items.quote:
ac ſi pro hac curua
itidem definiatur valor formulae $\int Z\,dx$, quaeritur,
quantum iſte valor a praecedente ſit diſcrepaturus
items.english: and if for this curve the value of the formula ∫Z dx is likewise determined, it is asked how much this value will differ from the preceding one

items.quote:
euidens enim eſt, hoc diſcrimen praebere ipſam
variationem quantitatis $W$
items.english: for it is evident that this difference gives the very variation of the quantity W

items.quote:
quaeritur tempus quo corpus ex puncto A ſuper hac
curua AM deſcendens vsque ad punctum M per-
tingit
items.english: the time is sought in which a body descending from point A along this curve AM reaches point M

items.quote:
quare nunc tempus erit definiendum, quo corpus
ſuper curua quacunque proxima $\alpha\mu$ deſcendens ab
$\alpha$ vsque ad $\mu$ perueniet
items.english: therefore the time must now be determined in which a body descending along any nearby curve αμ will travel from α to μ

items.quote:
ante omnia diſpiciendum eſt, quomo-
do eam determinari oporteat
items.english: before all else it must be examined how it ought to be determined
